producer_observations.appsettings: Existing azure_app_settings_secret_indicators._scan requests bound selected site GET then appsettings/list POST under explicit content_secret_scans. _content feeds literals to engines and discards raw data; it does NOT emit appSettingsMetadata booleans or FUNCTIONS_EXTENSION_VERSION. Old azure_ports_tail_context.instrumentation/extension_version are source definitions, not active registered replacements.
producer_observations.logs: Existing selected workspace sample reader whitelists AppTraces and FunctionAppLogs and fixed Message query; APIM gateway columns/table are outside that contract. Query POST is read-only but requires separate named bounded profile and actual log permissions, not generic ARM Reader assumption.
producer_observations.Flex: azure_functions_runtime_native.safe_site_inventory preserves only documented functionAppConfig runtime.name/version and memory. Existing function_settings consumer still requires approved expected settings and is archived; it cannot replace a policy-free version declaration.

reasons: Mirrors the claude_azure review: the pinned query reads a workspace parameter that does not express managed-services / disk CMK configuration in the documented ARM schema.

Upstream bug: it tests parameters -> 'customerManagedKeyId', which does not exist in Microsoft.Databricks/workspaces WorkspaceCustomParameters (amlWorkspaceId, customPrivateSubnetName, customPublicSubnetName, customVirtualNetworkId, enableNoPublicIp, encryption, loadBalancer*, natGatewayName, prepareEncryption, publicIpName, requireInfrastructureEncryption, storageAccount*, vnetAddressPrefix), so every workspace alarms. Managed-disk CMK is covered by azure.claude.databricks_managed_disk_cmk.

assessment.required_native_fields: Workspaces properties.encryption.entities.managedDisk/managedServices.keyVaultProperties; not parameters.customerManagedKeyId
assessment.counterexample_or_limit: A valid managedDisk keyVaultProperties configuration lacks fictitious customerManagedKeyId and falsely alarms. Managed-services scope is distinct.

reasons: Upstream bug: the EXISTS subquery is not correlated to the VM, so the status reflects whether any VM in the subscription has a NIC. Its intent (a VM has a network interface) is always true for ARM VMs, which cannot be created without a NIC, so it carries no security signal.

assessment.required_native_fields: VM networkProfile.networkInterfaces and each exact NIC ipConfigurations.subnet.id
assessment.counterexample_or_limit: Source EXISTS reads every NIC without correlating VM NIC; one unrelated subnet makes any VM pass. It also refers a.vm_id although native table join uses a.id. Native NIC/subnet associations are already assessed by narrower network controls.

reasons: Upstream query reads azure_eventgrid_domain (not topics) and alarms when disableLocalAuth is true, i.e. it rewards enabling key/SAS local authentication. secret_storage.counterexample_or_limit: Presence of a vault or one reference cannot prove all application secrets are stored there; selected dual-engine scans cover only explicitly selected literals.

language_lifecycle.required_native_fields: ARM config/web linuxFxVersion/javaVersion/phpVersion/pythonVersion/netFrameworkVersion and current regional availableStacks metadata
language_lifecycle.counterexample_or_limit: A pinned literal baseline is not current latest; supported older LTS and custom-container applicability need explicit lifecycle semantics.

defender_plans.required_native_fields: ARM Microsoft.Security/pricings pricingTier/subPlan/extensions and actual IoT resource applicability
defender_plans.counterexample_or_limit: Standard subscription pricing is not proof every resource is protected or alerts monitored.

defender_extensions.counterexample_or_limit: Extension name and true string require the correct pricing plan; deprecated MMA autoprovisioning is not an equivalent.

app_http_logs.required_native_fields: ARM diagnosticSettings logs category AppServiceHTTPLogs/enabled and destination
app_http_logs.counterexample_or_limit: HTTP logging declaration does not prove every request was ingested.

entra_rbac_auth.required_native_fields: Native service-specific disableLocalAuth/authenticationType and role assignments
entra_rbac_auth.counterexample_or_limit: Generic use where possible requires service applicability; disabling local auth and RBAC grants must be assessed separately.

public_ip_review.required_native_fields: ARM publicIPAddresses plus customer review records/time window
public_ip_review.counterexample_or_limit: IP allocation metadata and Shodan absence do not prove periodic owner evaluation. Optional Azure log reads do not supply review approval.

benchmark_policy.required_native_fields: ARM policyAssignments policyDefinitionId/parameters/enforcementMode plus policySetDefinitions and exemptions
benchmark_policy.counterexample_or_limit: A policy assignment alone does not prove every benchmark member is enabled or unexempted; customer baseline/version needed.

easm.counterexample_or_limit: Provisioned workspace is a bounded native declaration, not proof all external assets are discovered or reviewed.

cross_tenant_replication.counterexample_or_limit: False is a current native property; missing field is not implicit false.

mfa.required_native_fields: Graph conditionalAccessPolicies state/conditions/users/applications/grantControls plus users, directory/PIM/ARM role assignments
mfa.counterexample_or_limit: MFA registration/capability is not universal enforced MFA. Exclusions, report-only, OR grants and unsupported conditions cannot establish universal coverage.

basic_auth.counterexample_or_limit: SCM/FTP publish credential policy is distinct from app-user authentication.

mmk_only.counterexample_or_limit: Microsoft.Keyvault CMK is encrypted too; an MMK-only check wrongly flags stronger encryption.

databricks_data_plane.required_native_fields: Azure Databricks workspace ARM encryption/parameters; workspace SCIM/metastore/token policy requires separately authenticated Databricks API
databricks_data_plane.counterexample_or_limit: ARM workspace private networking is not proof of SCIM synchronization, inter-node TLS, Unity Catalog assignment or token expiry. Do not use ARM tokens for data-plane APIs.

legacy_auth_settings.required_native_fields: Legacy SSPR/MFA portal settings; supported Graph authenticationMethodsPolicy does not expose every portal SSPR number/notification/reconfirmation/remembered-device switch
legacy_auth_settings.counterexample_or_limit: Optional content/log reads do not make an undocumented tenant-setting endpoint authoritative. Do not infer reset notifications from MFA registration; narrower supported auth-method controls exist.

user_consent.counterexample_or_limit: An assigned custom consent policy needs its own permission-grant-condition analysis; empty policy set is distinct from denied data.

legacy_portal_preferences.required_native_fields: Graph authorizationPolicy/groupSettings only where documented; legacy portal UX restrictions and actual authorization are distinct
legacy_portal_preferences.counterexample_or_limit: Hiding an admin portal or My Groups page is not authorization and supported Graph configuration does not prove these legacy UI-only toggles. Optional content readers do not expose tenant admin UX settings.

m365_group_creation.counterexample_or_limit: Portal-only observations do not cover API creation; restricted group policy does not revoke existing groups.

locks_custom_role.counterexample_or_limit: A custom role definition with locks/write is not an assigned role; require native definition/assignment identity join. Root-scope CustomRole is unsupported; subscription custom lock-role control is separate.

tenant_transfer.counterexample_or_limit: Only both true block both directions; authenticated tenant binding and complete policy are required.

device_code.counterexample_or_limit: Report-only block or excluded users cannot prove blocking; unsupported conditional context stays unresolved.

risky_signin.counterexample_or_limit: Risk MFA must be enabled and mandatory for the selected risks; an OR password-change alternative is insufficient.

admin_daily_use.required_native_fields: Graph signInActivity/signIn logs plus directory roles and designated separate administrator identity policy
admin_daily_use.counterexample_or_limit: A native role assignment or one management sign-in cannot establish that the same identity is never used for daily work.

access_reviews.required_native_fields: Graph accessReviews definitions/instances/decisions, scope query, start/end/status; direct/PIM assignments
access_reviews.counterexample_or_limit: A scheduled review is not a completed current review; assignment coverage, recurrence and customer cadence are separate.

smart_lockout.required_native_fields: Graph directorySettings Password Rule Settings LockoutThreshold/LockoutDurationInSeconds
smart_lockout.counterexample_or_limit: Missing tenant setting/default cannot be replaced with an invented effective value.

password_protection.counterexample_or_limit: An enabled policy does not prove every password or on-premises agent enforcement.

monitorable_sku.required_native_fields: Service-specific ARM SKU and diagnosticSettingsCategories availability
monitorable_sku.counterexample_or_limit: Basic/Consumption names are not universal capability flags across Azure services; require service-specific native capability, not a global SKU blacklist.

hsm_policy.required_native_fields: ARM vaults/managedHSMs SKU/provisioningState/identity and organization requirement
hsm_policy.counterexample_or_limit: A provisioned HSM can be read but cannot decide when the organization requires HSM-backed key custody.

passwordless.counterexample_or_limit: Enabled FIDO2/passkey policy is observable; it is not proof passwordless adoption or the organization having considered it.

token_protection.counterexample_or_limit: A session-control declaration does not cover unsupported clients/platforms or decide whether a policy should be considered.

nsp.counterexample_or_limit: A perimeter existence is not enforcement for a selected PaaS resource; association in Learning/Audit mode differs from Enforced.

alert_monitoring.required_native_fields: ARM securityContacts notificationSources + diagnostics and selected event windows
alert_monitoring.counterexample_or_limit: Notification routing declarations do not prove human monitoring or response.

adaptive_controls.required_native_fields: Defender recommendations/assessments with exact resourceDetails and current feature lifecycle
adaptive_controls.counterexample_or_limit: A healthy unrelated assessment cannot establish application allowlisting or implemented network recommendations; read recommendations, never execute guest commands.

vm_backup.counterexample_or_limit: Vault existence alone does not prove VM backup association or recovery success.

vulnerability_remediation.required_native_fields: Defender assessments/subAssessments status.code/resourceDetails.id + exact finding applicability
vulnerability_remediation.counterexample_or_limit: Configured scanner/Standard pricing is not proof that all findings are resolved.

image_builder.required_native_fields: ARM imageTemplates.properties.vnetConfig.subnetId and proxyVmSize/isolation properties as documented
image_builder.counterexample_or_limit: A subnet reference is not a Private Endpoint; validate native isolation configuration and exact subnet binding.

guest_baselines.required_native_fields: ARM GuestConfiguration assignments and latest report resources/complianceStatus + exact baseline parameters
guest_baselines.counterexample_or_limit: An aggregate Compliant report without the required setting or current VM binding cannot prove the named guest baseline; no host exec or file reads.

private_vm_nsg.required_native_fields: ARM VM networkProfile NIC IDs and NIC/subnet networkSecurityGroup.id
private_vm_nsg.counterexample_or_limit: No public IP is not NSG protection; exact NIC/subnet join required.

host_encryption.required_native_fields: ARM VM securityProfile.encryptionAtHost or documented applicable diskEncryptionSet
host_encryption.counterexample_or_limit: Disk-at-rest encryption does not alone encrypt temp disks/cache and all data flows.

databox_double.required_native_fields: ARM DataBox/jobs properties.details.jobStages and device-specific doubleEncryptionStatus
databox_double.counterexample_or_limit: Do not infer double encryption from a Standard SKU or a device unlock-key CMK declaration.

databox_cmk.counterexample_or_limit: Native key-encryption-key reference can be read without retrieving device unlock password.

certificate_lifetime.required_native_fields: Key Vault certificates metadata attributes.nbf/exp + certificate policy validityInMonths
certificate_lifetime.counterexample_or_limit: No certificate private value is needed; required maximum is customer policy, and policy duration alone does not prove each issued certificate.

kubernetes_guest_policy.required_native_fields: AKS ARM configuration plus selected authenticated Kubernetes PodSpec/API policy evidence
kubernetes_guest_policy.counterexample_or_limit: ARM AKS identity does not contain running PodSpecs or policy enforcement; native Kubernetes controls cover selected workload declarations, not effective runtime.

retired_ise.counterexample_or_limit: Integration Service Environment retired 2024-08-31; Logic Apps Standard is a different current resource/hosting model.

ml_private.counterexample_or_limit: Approved endpoint declaration is not effective end-to-end data isolation.

saved_query_storage.counterexample_or_limit: A linked storage account declaration is observable; encryption/key usability and query results remain separate.

log_cluster_cmk.required_native_fields: ARM OperationalInsights/clusters properties.keyVaultProperties and native identity
log_cluster_cmk.counterexample_or_limit: Configuration-only native successor checks reference and identity; key usability needs forbidden contents/decrypt and is not inferred.

cluster_double.counterexample_or_limit: Known false differs from missing/denied; infrastructure encryption declaration does not test data use.

firewall_route.required_native_fields: ARM subnet routeTable and routes destination/nextHopType/nextHopIpAddress plus actual firewall IP
firewall_route.counterexample_or_limit: A default route alone does not prove every flow reaches that firewall; customer-approved firewall and exact subnet join are required.

recovery_cmk.counterexample_or_limit: CMK declaration does not prove a successful recovery or native key usability.

stream_job_cmk.counterexample_or_limit: job.encryption.keySource is fictitious; only uniquely bound external job storage CMK declaration is supported.

webpubsub_private.counterexample_or_limit: Approved native endpoint is different from pending/rejected; public access and effective reachability remain separate.

app_registration.counterexample_or_limit: Application registration restriction does not limit existing application privileges.

guest_access.counterexample_or_limit: Known Guest User role template is not the Restricted Guest User template; resource grants remain separate.

guest_invite.counterexample_or_limit: everyone permits guests; adminsAndGuestInviters is narrower but does not prove all existing guests were reviewed.

security_group_creation.counterexample_or_limit: API restriction must be checked on tenant policy; individual group existence proves nothing.

security_defaults.counterexample_or_limit: An enabled declared policy does not test each sign-in; known false differs from denied policy.

geographic.counterexample_or_limit: A geographic policy existing is not an organization decision identifying prohibited countries; policy applicability needs exact exclusions.

tenant_creation.counterexample_or_limit: False restricts default users, not privileged Tenant Creator role holders.

def evaluate_native(site, settings, *, selected_site, subscription_id,
                    site_status=200, settings_status=200):
    """Return only fixed prose/booleans, never a setting value or exception body."""
    unresolved = ('UNKNOWN', {'observed': 'The selected Function telemetry setting declaration could not be established.'})
    if (type(site_status) is not int or site_status != 200
            or type(settings_status) is not int or settings_status != 200):
        return unresolved
    match = _SITE.fullmatch(selected_site) if isinstance(selected_site, str) else None
    if (not match or not isinstance(subscription_id, str)
            or match[1].casefold() != subscription_id.casefold()
            or any(part in ('.', '..') for part in selected_site.split('/'))
            or not isinstance(site, dict) or not isinstance(settings, dict)):
        return unresolved
    if ('error' in site or not isinstance(site.get('id'), str) or site['id'].casefold() != selected_site.casefold()
            or str(site.get('type', '')).casefold() != 'microsoft.web/sites'
            or not isinstance(site.get('properties'), dict) or not isinstance(site.get('kind'), str)
            or 'functionapp' not in {part.strip().casefold() for part in site['kind'].split(',')}):
        return unresolved
    if ('error' in settings or not isinstance(settings.get('id'), str)
            or settings['id'].casefold() != (selected_site + '/config/appsettings').casefold()
            or str(settings.get('type', '')).casefold() != 'microsoft.web/sites/config'
            or settings.get('name') != 'appsettings' or not isinstance(settings.get('properties'), dict)):
        return unresolved
    properties = settings['properties']
    if len(properties) > 2048 or any(not isinstance(k, str) or not isinstance(v, str) for k, v in properties.items()):
        return unresolved
    # The native dictionary has case-sensitive keys; ambiguous aliases are not
    # silently combined. References/masks do not prove a literal declaration.
    for key in _KEYS:
        if any(k.casefold() == key.casefold() and k != key for k in properties):
            return unresolved
    values = [properties.get(key, '') for key in _KEYS]
    if any(value.lstrip().casefold().startswith('@microsoft.keyvault')
           or value.strip() and set(value.strip()) <= {'*'} for value in values):
        return unresolved
    declared = any(value.strip() for value in values)
    return ('PASS' if declared else 'FAIL'), {
        'telemetry_setting_declared': bool(declared),
        'observed': ('The selected Function declares a nonempty Application Insights setting.' if declared
                     else 'The selected Function has no nonempty Application Insights setting.')
                    + ' Telemetry delivery and destination validity were not tested.'}
